name: rtl_to_inferred_spec_and_testplan
description: Build an inferred, RTL-engineer-review-required specification draft before the verification plan.

steps.description: Extract the top-level JSON port interface.
Build the source-backed hierarchy, control, clock and reset graph.
Draft a specification from the selected RTL using the generic template; every claim is inferred and needs RTL engineer review.
Ingest the inferred RTL-derived draft while preserving its source authority.
Extract review-required requirements from the inferred draft.
Create JSON, Markdown and HTML plans; all draft-derived checks remain inferred.
